description: 330pF 50V C0G ±5% 1206 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS
compatibility_notes: Second code on the existing generic 1206 330 pF capacitor: the plain generic ID keeps its reviewed preference C1862 (FH 1206B331K500NT, X7R +/-10% 50 V). C1907 is the exact FH C0G +/-5% SKU (1206CG331J500NT, 50 V) from the same maker, so it gets its own maker/mpn variant ID linked via generic_oomp_id, following the established variant taxonomy. Rating comparison from the staged capture: same 330 pF value, package and 50 V rating, but C0G +/-5% is the more stable, tighter-tolerance dielectric than the X7R +/-10% preference; projects needing C0G stability at 330 pF/1206 should pick this variant explicitly and the X7R preference is not downgraded. Two-terminal MLCC (pin_count 2); stock 4,002 recorded as observed. Edits made under the capacitor family lock.
